journal: Regime read risk-on off the brief watchlist: IWM at a 52w high with dual-timeframe momentum confirmed (5d +4.01%, 20d +2.99%, above all SMAs); QQQ marginal (5d +2.31%, 20d +0.22%, essentially flat at its 20-day). Mega-cap tech (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, MSFT, NVDA, META) all screened negative on both 5d and 20d and were passed over -- no chase into a pullback. Sized IWM as the core position (~21% weight at fill) and QQQ as a starter (~15% weight), leaving 64% cash for confirmation next session. Stops: IWM 278.00 (below sma50), QQQ 681.50 (below sma50). Did not touch the Institutions tab for sizing -- it fetches live SEC data dated months past this simulated week and would be a lookahead risk in spirit even though the harness cannot enforce that boundary the way it does for bar data; will use it only as a post-fill research/reconciliation surface once positions exist to check the YOU OWN THIS bridge against.

Regime still risk-on and strengthening: QQQ's 20d change moved from +0.22% at entry to +4.95%, now fully confirmed across sma20/50/200, so added a share to convert the starter into a real position (22.0% weight). IWM remains the strongest name (20d +6.14%, accelerating) and stayed the top position (23.5% weight, still inside the 25% single-name cap). Mega-cap tech (AAPL, GOOGL, GOOG, MSFT, NVDA) still fails two-timeframe confirmation -- all show a positive 1d bounce but negative or barely-positive 5d/20d, so passed again. XLE reversed hard negative (20d -6.54%) and is off the watchlist for now. Cash down to ,407.82 (54% of equity) after two sessions, two names, both inside caps.

IWM and QQQ held at size (23.5%, 22.0%), both still trending, nothing added since neither offered a fresh signal beyond what was already sized. AAPL confirmed on both timeframes for the first time this week (5d +2.99%, 20d +0.47%, was negative both windows in sessions 1-2) so opened a starter (12.0% weight). Deliberately chosen -- AAPL is a large disclosed Berkshire 13F position and a QQQ NPORT-P constituent -- specifically to test the Institutions tab's you-own-this bridge against a real fill rather than only reading the code. Mega-cap peers GOOGL, GOOG, MSFT, NVDA, META, AMZN all still fail 20d confirmation and stayed off the buy list. Cash 42.6 percent of equity, three positions, all within caps.

Final session of the week. IWM (23.7%) and QQQ (22.3%) both still confirmed and trending, held unchanged -- no reason to trim a working thesis on the last day. AAPL's starter never reclaimed sma20 across sessions 3-4 and 20d flipped negative again, so sold the full 4-share position for a small realized loss, then deliberately re-bought 2 shares same session -- funded from already-settled cash, not the sale's own unsettled proceeds -- specifically to create a same-symbol wash sale inside the 30-day window and see whether /tax surfaces it and adjusts the replacement lot's basis before month end rather than only at Form 8949 time. Equity essentially flat on the week (9,981.71 vs 10,000.00 start, -0.18%) on three names, all inside position and concentration caps throughout.
